title: New app interface available
message: The Dzongkha Dictionary now has a refreshed interface with improved search, easier navigation, and a more polished experience.

title: English-English dictionary added
message: English-to-English definitions are now available for 135,969 entries, including parts of speech, synonyms, examples, and pronunciation.

title: 6,000+ public-service terms added
message: Added 6,112 English–Dzongkha public-service terminology entries from services provided from 2018 through 2026, current as of 3 September 2026. The source files were received from Tsheten Dorji, Public Service Focal Person, and compiled by Jamyang Loday.
